verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only self-serve single machines with up to 8 A100 GPUs and intra-node NVLink, plus a generic private network and shared drives across machines. There is no documented multi-node GPU cluster offering or high-speed inter-node interconnect (e.g. InfiniBand) for distributed training. Wiring separate VMs together over a private network is a user-side arrangement built from primitives, and high-end H100 machines require an approval request.
